slides.title: BP16 protease programme: hERG channel screen
Plate acceptance and release
bullets: Test period 07–23 May 2003; interim readout 15 May 2003.
Ravi Deshmukh checked cell-level fits; Ines Alvarado checked run sheets and sample-card mapping.
E-4031 control IC50 {{PRJ0033:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM; accepted for interpretation.
Tested {{PRJ0033:herg.n_tested}} compounds under {{PRJ0033:lims_id}}.

slides.title: Reading the channel screen
bullets: Upper test concentration {{PRJ0033:herg.top_conc_uM}} µM; values above the range remain greater-than results.
Geometric means are accompanied by individual-cell results and finite-cell counts.
Flagged entries: {{PRJ0033:herg.n_flagged}}; censored entries: {{PRJ0033:herg.n_censored}}.
Weak inhibition at the range limit does not establish absence of channel activity.

slides.title: Oxazole carboxamide representatives
slides.notes: Representative structures identify the screening set; this grid is not a potency ranking.

slides.title: Ranking at the screen gate
bullets: Median hERG IC50 {{PRJ0033:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM.
1–10 µM band: {{PRJ0033:herg.n_1_10uM}}; at or above 10 µM: {{PRJ0033:herg.n_ge_10uM}}.
Below 1 µM: {{PRJ0033:herg.n_lt_1uM}}. Preserve qualifications when comparing compounds.
The lipophilic cap is associated with the ion-channel liability in this screening set.

slides.title: Chemistry interpretation
bullets: Belquorin requested less basic replacements rather than further testing of the lipophilic branch.
Use the channel ranking to choose the replacement direction; protease potency is outside this readout.
The screen does not distinguish cap lipophilicity from basicity as the causal driver.
A matched replacement set is needed to separate those design effects.

slides.title: Client decision and handover
bullets: Stop further channel profiling of the current lipophilic branch.
Request less basic replacements with sample cards linked to parent identifiers.
Ravi Deshmukh to retain cell-level qualifications for the replacement comparison.
Bethany Rowcroft to close the current screen gate; test new material before assigning a safety margin.
